captureRequirements.countingUnit: one paid Spin plus all adjacent Delivery/Step responses through the legal terminal state equals one complete Round

workflowAuthority.implementationGate: game-capabilities, protocol-spec and protocol-handoff must be evidence-backed and reviewed before implementing rules
workflowAuthority.artifactRootNote: If an official Agent AI execution is created on this Mac, the full official workflow form must first use /Volumes/hd/cpgame. This audit does not edit workflow state.

items.description: hms-home.js and hms-app.js hashes are recorded, but they are lobby shell inputs and not gid1810 game protocol evidence
collector configuration, schemas, status reports and protocol gap registers contain plans and UNKNOWN states only
server exposes only health/scaffold-status; generator and Redis loader refuse generation because implementationAllowed=false
existing JAR/class files prove only that the evidence gate scaffold was built; they are not a playable replica or rule evidence
v14 manual acceptance matrix is historical and cannot override current template v15

legacyTakeoverHazards.evidence: capture-session/collector-config/spin-index schema require abc224 while the declared backfill channel accepts abc222
legacyTakeoverHazards.requiredResolution: select the actual isolated account at dispatch, verify it visibly, then atomically make collector config, schema and every evidence row use that one alias

legacyTakeoverHazards.evidence: validate-round-coverage.mjs reads historyMatchRequired, targets.mary and targets.specialOrRewardDefault, but collector-config stores different nested/key names
legacyTakeoverHazards.requiredResolution: do not run the legacy validator as-is; use the current proven API-first collector/index validator or repair it with offline tests first
bind every output explicitly to captures/1810-Treasure-Hunt or reports/1810-Treasure-Hunt before live collection

legacyTakeoverHazards.evidence: legacy config allows at most 50 manual UI starts, which cannot satisfy v15 formal API evidence targets
legacyTakeoverHazards.requiredResolution: use API-first ORIGINAL_AUTHORIZED_HTTP capture; preserve any UI evidence under its distinct evidence type and never relabel it

legacyTakeoverHazards.evidence: directory-inventory says the category directories were empty skeletons, but fail-closed scaffolds now exist
legacyTakeoverHazards.requiredResolution: treat this readiness audit as the current inventory and keep the old file only as historical evidence

requiredBeforeFirstPaidStart: reserve one isolated browser/profile for the chosen account
visibly verify the chosen account immediately before launch
make all collector metadata use the same verified alias
obtain a fresh gid1810 launch token and keep it in memory only
allow token transmission only to the observed authorized game API host
persist no password, token, authorization header, cookie or credential-bearing URL
accountAndCredentialGate.userAuthorizationStatus: ALREADY_GRANTED_IN_PARENT_TASK; do not add a repetitive permission prompt

unknownRulesGate.existingJavaDisposition: retain as fail-closed scaffold only; replace or extend only after protocol evidence review

shortestSafeTakeoverWhenScheduled.action: Wait until raw gid60 collection handoff is complete, then assign exactly one collector writer to raw gid1810.

Copy the current proven API-first collector architecture; do not execute the legacy gid1810 collector/validator unchanged. Bind all paths to 1810-Treasure-Hunt and reject every non-1810 game identity.
Choose the available isolated account/profile, visibly reverify its alias, reconcile the abc224/abc222 metadata conflict, and obtain a fresh launch URL/token in memory only.

Use raw gid1810 to capture auth/config/init plus first-load, rules, lazy and language resources. Persist only redacted non-credential evidence and record the real endpoint/slug instead of guessing it.

Send one minimum-bet protocol probe, persist its exact authorized HTTP request/response evidence, determine Step continuation and legal terminal fields, and validate History list/detail identity before batching.
Batch complete Rounds by API: collect at least 200 LOSS, 200 WIN and 30 of every confirmed special/reward category, stopping early only when every applicable target is met or at 5000 paid starts.
Finalize History pagination/detail reconciliation 1:1 for every paid Round; fail closed on duplicate, missing, mismatched or ambiguous transactions.

Generate canonical spin/round/history indexes, scenario coverage, language/resource inventories and protocol evidence matrix; only then open a separate implementation task while the collector advances.

readinessDecision.reason: directory identity and fail-closed skeleton are usable, but there are zero formal samples and the legacy account/config/validator metadata must be normalized before the first live request
